long_biography.plain_text:
Patriarca founded an automobile drive-away business while at college. He then joined Patriarca Manufacturing, the company established by his father, and worked on modular retail fixtures. The experience placed him inside an established family enterprise before he shifted his attention to property.

Real estate became the center of a four-decade business career. He invested in and developed property while directly operating restaurants, hotels and marinas. He also held officer positions in several Florida maritime and property-related companies. In Rhode Island, he served as president of both Patriarca Manufacturing and Rhedom Realty. Those appointments show operating responsibility, but do not establish that every company asset belonged to him personally. His record combines entrepreneurial ventures with the advantage of an existing family manufacturing platform. It does not reveal the ownership percentage or financing behind each project, any outside-fund interest, or a complete personal net worth. Patriarca remained connected to Rhode Island while spending substantial time in Florida and the Caribbean. He died in Providence in 2014 at age 71.
